description: Parser on a pinned CI image whose effective toolchain is Go 1.17 — the genuine Go Version Gate hard stop, because testing.F does not exist in that toolchain
context: User asks to write a fuzz test on a pinned CI image. `go version` reports go1.17.13 and GOTOOLCHAIN=local, so no newer toolchain can be fetched. testing.F is genuinely unavailable. Contrast with 013, where only the go directive is low and the toolchain is modern.
expected_alternative: property tests with gopter/rapid, or legacy go-fuzz with explicit justification; alternatively upgrade the toolchain

version_gate.note: GOTOOLCHAIN=local prevents auto-upgrade, so the 1.17 toolchain is final
